rationales.authenticity: Period tone appropriate to how a practical woman would view folk stories; sídhe reference is spot-on.
rationales.character: Brigid's practical wariness—'minds her own business'—fits her character; doesn't claim knowledge she doesn't have.
rationales.craft: Three sentences but somewhat evasive—'no place for decent folk' is evocative but the rest is hedging.
rationales.language: Natural Irish English; 'so I do' is idiomatic; no errors.
rationales.responsiveness: Addresses the lights but mostly by deflecting; could have engaged more with the phenomenon.
